name: Speech Pathology & OT

emergency: sudden change in speech or swallowing
urgent review requested by a doctor

extra_prompt: You are booking for a speech pathology or occupational therapy practice. Ask about the client's age, diagnosis or concern, current supports, and funding (NDIS, Medicare, private). Ask about goals and whether school or kinder reports are available. Quote prices only from the reference answers, and say the final price is confirmed after assessment. Do not provide clinical advice or promise specific therapeutic outcomes.

kb.q: How much does a session cost?
kb.a: {price_note} Sessions are priced by length, and an assessment is priced separately. We confirm the fee before your first appointment.
Yes, we see NDIS participants. Ask us to confirm whether your plan covers speech pathology or occupational therapy before booking.
{bulk_bill_note} Ask your GP about a referral that may make you eligible for a Medicare rebate, and we will confirm what applies.
If your private health fund covers allied health, you may be able to claim. We can provide a receipt, so check your fund's allied health cover before booking.
Yes, telehealth sessions are available by video call for suitable goals. Tell us your needs so we can confirm whether telehealth suits you.
Yes, home visits are available in [your service area]. A home visit surcharge may apply and is shown on your quote.
Yes, school visits are available with the school's agreement and parent consent. A school visit surcharge applies and is listed in your quote.

kb.q: What ages do you work with?
kb.a: We work with children, teens and adults. Tell us the person's age and main concerns when you book.
Therapy sessions run 45 or 60 minutes, and an initial assessment runs 60 to 90 minutes. We confirm the length that suits your goals.
{waitlist_note} Ask us about the current wait time when you call.
Yes, we write reports for NDIS, schools and paediatricians. A written report is charged separately, as listed on your quote.
Yes, we run social and literacy groups. Group sessions are charged per person, as listed in our rates.

kb.q: How many sessions will we need?
kb.a: It depends on your goals and progress. We discuss a plan after the assessment and review it with you regularly.
Cancelling with less than {cancellation_notice} may incur a late cancellation fee. Please call us as early as you can.
Our therapists hold [registration body, e.g. SPA or AHPRA] registration and [insurance type] insurance. {certification_note}

kb.q: Do you work with adults after stroke?
kb.a: Yes, we work with adults after stroke, including speech and swallowing rehabilitation. Please bring any hospital or GP notes to the assessment.

required_information.label: Referral or Medicare details (only if the practice needs them)
Clinical details stay in the clinical record, not in booking notes

compliance.guidance: Health practitioners usually need registration (for example with AHPRA where it applies) and current professional indemnity insurance. Keep clinical details in the clinical record, not in general booking fields. Follow your state health privacy rules.
items: Clinical notes kept only in the clinical record
